license_scope: Upstream core source only; does not license external datasets, models, third-party executables, or hosted services.
inventory_method: Parse committed Python bytes with ast; never import or execute upstream code. Enumerate all public top-level function definitions in biomni/tool/*.py. Does not enumerate class methods, nested helper functions, or protocol documents.
status_semantics: Adapted entries name scoped source-derived capabilities. Deferred entries are an inventory, not installed or callable Proto tools. Native companion entries are separately authored Proto analysis capabilities, not claims of an upstream generic statistics module.
static_indicator_limit: Indicators are source-text observations only, not exhaustive dependency/effect analysis or proof of safety. function_local_imports excludes module-level imports, which appear on module records; transitive imports and external executable requirements need separate review.

batch_2_port.scope: Fifty additional offline tools ported under the copy-and-adapt policy: algorithm bodies transcribed from the pinned upstream commit, adapted only for JSON inputs, artifact-free structured results, and documented corrections of upstream defects.

batch_3_port.scope: Third wave: bounded binary file inputs (FCS/PDB/PNG/chain), fifteen additional offline tools across flow cytometry, structures, ML, imaging, and chemistry, plus a connector subsystem (network APIs, whitelisted executables, DDInter data lake) that ships disabled by default.

batch_4_port.scope: Fourth wave: the remaining feasible 39 tools — frame-sequence microscopy (migration, calcium, motility, immune flow, ciliary), histology (CNS, IHC, thrombus, aorta, cornea, multiplex, microCT, amyloid, rhod2, ROI), medical registration (rigid/affine/deformable/batch/similarity/preprocess/modality split/segmentation summary), NIfTI (face surface, ADC), and popgen (msprime, cooler, cobra perturbation, DDR network, Cas9 outcomes, CRISPR editing).
